subject: Future Tech
title: Cochlear Implants as BCIs
description: Learn Cochlear Implants as BCIs in one minute.

hook.text: The cochlear implant is the world's most successful brain-computer interface. Over a million people use one.

buildup.text: A microphone captures sound, a processor converts it to electrical signals, and electrodes stimulate the auditory nerve.

discovery.text: The first cochlear implant was approved in 1984. Children born deaf can now develop spoken language with one.

climax.text: Despite limitations, cochlear implants proved that machines can write meaningful information into the nervous system.

punchline.text: A chip gave a million people the gift of sound.

quiz.question: How many people worldwide use cochlear implants?
